items.title: LIVE: Brent cools to $105 as Trump says deal with Iran can emerge "very quickly" | Opening Bell
items.description: Sensex and Nifty are set for a firm start on Thursday amid strong global cues after Wall Street rallied over 1 percent overnight and Asian markets surged on easing concerns around an immediate escalation in the Iran conflict. GIFT Nifty was trading at 23,803 around 8 am, up 138 points or 0.58 percent, indicating a strong opening for domestic benchmark indices. Crude oil prices rebounded slightly in early trade after tumbling over 5.5 percent overnight as hopes of a possible US-Iran deal improved risk sentiment globally. Technology, chip and export-linked stocks rallied globally after strong earnings from Nvidia and easing labour concerns at Samsung Electronics, while investors continued to monitor oil prices, the rupee and FII flows closely. Catch Lovisha Darad in conversation with Market experts
